subtasks: Place the alarm clock on the drawer, put the figurine on the stand, place the mouse on the mouse pad, and push the keyboard into the frame.
Center the keyboard over the outlined frame by sliding it slightly to the right and a little toward the monitor. Leave the clock, figurine and mouse in place, then return both arms to start.
Leave the arranged objects undisturbed. Withdraw the right hand from the keyboard, then return both open grippers to their respective starting poses.
Center the upright figurine's round base on the small square stand immediately left of the keyboard. Leave the clock, mouse and keyboard undisturbed and return both grippers to their starting poses.
Leave the upright figurine on the stand and the other arranged objects undisturbed. Withdraw the open left hand upward and back, and return both open grippers to their respective episode-start poses.
